 We are looking for an experienced Delivery Manager to manage recruitment delivery, lead a team of recruiters, and ensure timely fulfillment of client hiring requirements. The ideal candidate should have strong experience in a recruitment agency or staffing firm, excellent team management skills, and a proven track record of achieving recruitment targets.

 \- Track individual and team performance against KPIs.

 \- Identify performance gaps and implement corrective action plans.
 



 \- Motivate the team to achieve sourcing, interview, and closure targets.

 \- Coordinate with clients and hiring managers to understand hiring needs and priorities.

 \- Participate in client calls and requirement discussions.

 \- Resolve delivery\-related issues and ensure high levels of client satisfaction.

 \- Maintain and review recruitment dashboards, trackers

 \- Prepare daily, weekly, and monthly performance reports.
 



 \- Ensure proper usage and updating of ATS and recruitment databases.
 



 \- Maintain data accuracy and ensure compliance with recruitment processes.

 \- Monthly and quarterly recruitment closures
 



 \- Team productivity and target achievement
 



 \- Submission\-to\-interview ratio
 



 \- Interview\-to\-selection ratio
 



 \- Offer\-to\-joining ratio
 



 \- Requirement Turnaround Time (TAT)
 



 \- Candidate quality and retention
 



 \- Client satisfaction and repeat requirements
 



 \- Individual recruiter performance
 



  





 Required Skills \& Experience
 



  





 \- 5\+ years of experience in agency recruitment, staffing, or recruitment consultancy.

 \- Strong understanding of the complete recruitment lifecycle.
 



 \- Experience handling multiple clients and requirements simultaneously.
 



 \- Strong sourcing and candidate evaluation knowledge.
 



 \- Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
 



 \- Strong target orientation and ability to work under pressure.
 



 \- Good analytical and reporting skills.
 



 \- Experience with ATS, recruitment portals, CRM, and MS Excel / Google Sheets.
 



 \- Strong leadership, mentoring, and problem\-solving abilities.
 



  





 Preferred Candidate Profile
 



  





 \- Experience in a recruitment agency, staffing company, RPO, or talent consultancy.
 



 \- Proven track record of achieving and exceeding recruitment targets.
 



 \- Ability to manage both people and delivery effectively.
 



 \- Strong client\-facing and negotiation skills.
 



 \- Hands\-on approach toward critical or urgent requirements.
 



 \- Ability to build a high\-performing recruitment team.
 



  





 What We Offer

 \- Opportunity to lead and grow a recruitment delivery team.

 \- Career growth opportunities within the organization.
 



 \- Performance\-driven and professional work environment.
